title: The School Fete
hook: 游园会上有充气城堡、画脸和气球，可恐龙气球一个都没有，爸爸只好自己动手。

cells.a: It was the day of the school fete.
cells.cn: 今天是学校游园会的日子。

cells.a: She said, “I like the bouncy castle the best!”
She asked if he was sure they had dinosaur balloons.
cells.cn: 她问爸爸确定有恐龙气球吗。

cells.a: They asked, “Would you like your face painted?”

cells.q: Why did someone say tigers are big cats?
cells.a: Because tigers are big cats, like the family cat.
cells.cn: 因为老虎就是大个的猫。

cells.a: They like to lick themselves clean.
cells.cn: 它们喜欢舔自己来保持干净。

cells.q: What did the children ask for?
cells.a: They said, “We'd like some balloons, please.”
cells.cn: 他们说：“我们想要几个气球。”

cells.q: What was the problem with the balloons?
cells.a: There were no dinosaur balloons at all.
He made a dinosaur out of a long balloon.
cells.cn: 他用长气球做了一只恐龙。
